name: Hurika

facts.text: Hurika is a level-85 creature with 100,000 health, Torst's mate on the high ledge; the original patrol flight is switched off.
A gust from her wings sends a random attacker flying into the air.
A June 2003 Allakhazam comment asks if anyone has ever killed 'this bird'; a European raid of about 60 answered that they did, by bolt-pulling her down.

story:
Hurika is the hen of the griffon roost and the larger of the two, a griffon icewing so old the iarn dwarves say their grandmothers' grandmothers saw her fly. Where Torst freezes the air, she simply moves it: one beat of her wings and a man is in the sky with nothing under him, tumbling, and then he is not in the sky any more. Her feathers are white as frost and her quills are prized beyond anything in Midgard by fletchers, who will not say what they make of them.

She is guarding a nest, and she has no other thought. The griffon chicks of the glacier are small and loud and grey, and they spend their first winters on the high ledge learning to fly into the wind that their mother makes. Hurika does not tolerate anything near them. The hrimthursa say she once threw an icelord off the ledge for coming too close, and the icelords say nothing at all, which the giants take as confirmation. The wind-riders of the island count it a great deed just to see her fly and live.

In the old days she and Torst flew long circuits over the glacier together, and the giants watched the sky for them; today she keeps the ledge, and whoever climbs to it learns why the wind-riders talk about her the way sailors talk about storms. She fights beside Torst. While he freezes the air into hunting eddies, she seizes a fighter with a gust and flings him upward, high above the ledge, and the fall does what her beak does not.

When she falls at last, wings spread wide, the chicks go silent. The wind-riders who have seen it say that is the worst sound on Aegir.
legend: Hurika throws people up into the air. Healers stay back from the edge, and anyone thrown gets healed fast when they land. Kill her with Torst or she keeps throwing while you work on him. Old raiders say bolt-pull her down to the flat ground, and that a fall from her ledge is the longest corpse run in Midgard. A 2003 raid of about 60 did it that way. Somebody always tries to catch the person she throws. Healers who stand at the back near the wall are hardest for her to throw off the edge. Use root-break if you can.

loremasterTopic.text: The hen of the griffon roost, larger than her mate [Torst]. One beat of her wings puts a man in the sky. She is guarding a nest and has no other thought.

bookPage: From the logbook of Asmund, wind-rider. Eighth attempt on the glacier roost, spring. We did not reach the ledge. The hen rose when we were still over the crater and came at us head-on, and I have never seen anything so large move so fast. She did not strike. She beat her wings once and the whole sky turned over, and we were falling, all three of us, and our griffons only caught the air again a stone's throw above the ice. She went back to her nest. She did not even look back. I think she was telling us something. I think it was: no.
